name: The Great Build
desc:
What can we build when everyone shares a little gratitude? Spoiler: something very, very tall.

Our community is what makes Roblox, Roblox. So from November 25 to 30, we’re giving everyone a chance to express what they’re grateful for. Every message of gratitude becomes a block in one giant tower built by players all over the world.

Here's the plan:
🧱 Grab your free block. A fresh one drops every hour.
🧱 Pick your message of gratitude. Choose what you're grateful for, from everyday things to your favorite influencers, and how you want to say it. Your username goes on it.
🧱 Send it up. Your block finds its spot in the tower, and up it goes.
🧱 Explore the tower and see what everyone else is grateful for.
🧱 Unlock free UGC together as the tower hits new milestones.

Come back every hour to add another message and see how high it's gone.

We’ll see you at the top.
